# Test: grove exec completes directories with branches, including the current worktree
setup_workspace feature/auth develop

exec grove add feature/auth
exec grove add develop

cd $WORK/workspace/main
exec grove __complete exec ''
stdout 'feature-auth\tfeature/auth'
stdout '^feature/auth'
stdout '^main\tmain$'
stdout '^develop\tdevelop$'
! stdout '^develop$'

exec grove __complete exec feature-auth ''
! stdout 'feature-auth'
! stdout 'feature/auth'
stdout '^main\tmain$'

exec grove __complete exec feature/auth ''
! stdout 'feature-auth'
! stdout 'feature/auth'

exec grove __complete exec feature/
stdout '^feature/auth$'
! stdout 'feature-auth'

exec git worktree add --detach ../detached HEAD
exec grove __complete exec ''
stdout '^detached$'
! stdout '^detached\t'

exec grove __complete exec -- ''
! stdout 'feature-auth'
! stdout 'feature/auth'
stdout ':0'
